test_evidence: cocsim_tests: all eighteen projectile-delivery ranged weapon paths emit EventType::Projectile; Inferno Tower remains the separately tested immediate-beam exception. Eagle uses its 200-housing activation threshold and its sourced 3 × 0.75-second burst with 10-second pause survives snapshot restoration.

cocsim_tests: Multi Archer Tower launches exactly three deterministic projectiles from its normal mode. Multi Gear Tower executes both its normal weapon and the sourced fast-attack four-shot burst; the latter is snapshot/restoration equivalent at its rule-quantised cadence.

cocsim_tests: Scattershot uses its immutable 90-degree rear-cone contract: direct, one-tile and outer falloff damage are distinct, a lateral unit is excluded, and a unit at the other altitude is excluded; its in-flight projectile survives snapshot/restoration.
cocsim_tests: Thrower L4 uses its current sourced hitpoints, damage, cadence, range, housing and TH18/Laboratory requirements; the regular projectile path survives snapshot/restoration.

cocsim_tests: Electro Titan L5 uses its normal one-tick logical whip projectile and a separately sourced 0.4-second, 3.5-tile aura. The aura hits ground and air entities but excludes Walls, is unaffected by Rage and continues through Freeze; its next pulse is snapshot/restoration equivalent.

cocsim_tests: Cannon one-tick projectile with snapshot and replay equivalence (same in-flight id, deadline and impact), Core event geometry for a Minion projectile, Seeking Air Mine in-flight motion, target-loss terminal impact without damage with snapshot/replay restoration, snapshot migration, replay, observer isolation and simultaneous projectile identities.
th18_rl_runtime_validation: Python observation exposes in-flight Seeking Air Mine id and trajectory fields, plus a one-tick Cannon projectile with its Core-scheduled impact deadline.

headless_gui_isolation_validation: GUI projectile rendering does not link into Core or RL; it receives immutable PresentationSnapshot values from the sole BattleState-owning simulation bridge and cannot submit or advance combat directly.
cocsim_viewer_thread_tests: an SDL-free bridge test resets at T+0, transports a value-only deployment command, advances only fixed ticks, and publishes coherent immutable inventory/entity state.
